title: Threat Model Compiler
description: Compiles a structured threat model for a feature or system. Enforces: STRIDE categories used correctly, risk scores are valid, all high-risk threats have mitigations, every asset has at least one threat, trust boundaries are named, mitigations reference a downstream security compiler, and LLM/AI surfaces are addressed if present.

error_codes.TM001: threat-model-spec.json missing or invalid — required fields: assets[], threats[], trustBoundaries[]
error_codes.TM002: Threat uses invalid STRIDE category — must be one of: Spoofing, Tampering, Repudiation, InformationDisclosure, DenialOfService, ElevationOfPrivilege
error_codes.TM003: Risk score format invalid — use likelihood (1-5) × impact (1-5) = total (1-25), or CVSS 0.0-10.0
error_codes.TM004: High-risk threat (score ≥15 or CVSS ≥7.0) has no mitigation — all high threats require a documented mitigation
error_codes.TM005: One or more assets have no associated threat — every asset in scope must have at least one threat enumerated
error_codes.TM006: Trust boundaries not named or not associated with threats — name all trust boundaries and link relevant threats
error_codes.TM007: Mitigation does not reference a security compiler output — mitigations must point to: authz-policy, input-validation-policy, rate-limit-policy, etc.
error_codes.TM008: System includes LLM/AI surfaces but no prompt injection or model abuse threats are documented
